keep.text: Agar aap log Google karoge
ki best diet in the world, toh answer aayega Mediterranean.
Ab Indian thaali dekhoge toh aap logon ko samajh mein aayega,
farak ekdam saaf dikhega.
Salad, ekdam check.
Fermented food, achaar,
aur isko probiotics bhi bolte hain.
Dahi, probiotics.
Do type ki sabzi, fiber.
Daal, protein.
Roti chawal, carb.
Haalanki daal mein itni zyada protein nahi hoti hai, but
paneer
aur
soya,
ye saari cheezein toh achhe protein mein gini jaati hain.
Ghee, sabse healthy fat.
Buttermilk, probiotic,
and hydration ke liye bhi bahut achha.
Chalo sabse pehle achaar ke baare mein bhi baat kar lete hain. Aaj probiotic supplements ka market
500 crore se bhi zyada ka hai.
Logon ko
pata hi nahi hai ki hamare ghar mein hi sabse bada probiotic raha hai.
Achaar fermented hota hai aur usmein lactobacillus
bacteria hote hain,
aur ye wahi bacteria hote hain jo
bahut hi expensive probiotic capsules mein aate hain.
Dahi mein bhi Lactobacillus aur Acidophilus bacteria hoti hai.
Aur idli dosa batter poora ka poora fermented hai, kaanji fermented hai,
aur ye sab gut ke microbiome ka khaana hai.
Yoga hamara tha, Western
sabhyata ne isko
billion dollar industry bana diya.
Turmeric hamari thi, usko latte bana diya.
Aur meditation hamara tha, West ne isko Headspace bana kar ek app mein convert kar diya.
Hamari
jo daadi pehle se karti rahi hain, usko
ab ye log meal sequencing kehte hain.
Hum log kya karte hain? Hum log apna chhod karke
doosron ko follow karte hain.
Quinoa laate hain, rajma se better protein mil jaata hai.
Avocado laate hain, desi ghee se bhi same fat mil jaata hai.
Kyunki Haryana aur Punjab waale log
bina desi ghee ke kuch bhi khaate hain,
aur wo log hum logon se zyada mazboot bhi hain.
Almond milk le aate hain hum log, makkhan bhi bahut zyada powerful hai bhai saab,
bahut zyada nutrition hai ismein.
Main apne
ek health protocol mein
maine ye saara ka saara cheez
jo Western ingredients nahi hai,
moong daal hai, sattu hai, paneer hai,
chicken,
chana daal,
kaala chana hai,
haldi, ghee, achaar.
Ghar ka khaana hai sab ka sab,
aur Indian kitchen mein hi banta hai, Indian budget mein hi banta hai, Indian body ke liye ekdam real solution hai.
Same baat hai, but alag alag bhasha mein ye saari cheezein chalti rehti hain.
Agar aap logon ko bhi same ye health protocol chahiye toh comment box mein likhiye HP
aur
link le karke chale jaaiye is poore health protocol ka.
Mera kaam tha science pahunchana,
decision aapka hai.

next video mein!
